title: Prisoners by State and Sex
description: Number of prisoners in Malaysia by state and sex from 2017 to 2022.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: prisoners
fields.title: Number of Prisoners
fields.description: [Integer] The number of prisoners as of 31st December in the given year

methodology:
In Malaysia, there are two types of prisoners:

- **Convicted prisoners**: Individuals who have been convicted of a crime and subsequently imprisoned.
- **Remand prisoners**: Individuals who have been detained and are awaiting trial.

This data shows the total number of prisoners, both convicted and remand, and is tabulated from the individual-level administrative records of prisoners managed by the Prisons Department, which is the single source of truth for all prison data in Malaysia.
caveat: This data is intended to provide a snapshot of the prison population as at the end of each reporting year. It should not be used to assess trends in crime, recidivism, or other criminal justice indicators.
